items.title: Improve App Connectivity
items.rationale: 103 negative reviews and 13 neutral reviews indicate significant issues with app connectivity, which is a critical feature for a Bluetooth tracker.

items.title: Enhance Customer Service
items.rationale: 46 negative reviews and 1 neutral review indicate poor customer service experiences, which can lead to loss of customer trust and loyalty.

items.title: Address Setup Issues
items.rationale: 101 negative reviews and 16 neutral reviews indicate significant difficulties with setting up the JioTag, which can lead to frustration and abandonment.

items.title: Investigate Battery Life Concerns
items.rationale: 7 negative reviews and 1 neutral review indicate battery life issues, which can impact user experience and satisfaction.

items.title: Improve Compatibility with Devices
items.rationale: 16 negative reviews and 13 neutral reviews indicate compatibility issues with various devices, which can limit the product's appeal and usability.
